public_rationale: A February 27, 2022 GAMA interview identifies Jesse Lyu as its CEO [e1]. Rabbit's January 9, 2024 launch announcement supports his founding role and presents its R1 as a consumer AI device [e2]. A May 24, 2024 report records Rabbit's acknowledgment of its 2023 rebranding from Cyber Manufacture [e3]. These records support the historical role, Rabbit founding and product components, and corporate rebranding, but do not establish whether Lyu remained GAMA's CEO on May 6, 2024 [e1–e3]. Rabbit's May 24, 2024 statement says GAMA had concluded, but supplies no dated record establishing when his CEO role ended [e4]. The full claim therefore remains unresolved [e1–e4].
limitations: The historical GAMA title is documented in a community-hosted interview transcript [e1].
The rebranding report supports corporate continuity but does not directly verify the legal name-change filing [e3].
Rabbit's retrospective closure statement does not establish Lyu's GAMA CEO status on May 6, 2024 [e4].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Jesse Lyu was and is the CEO of GAMA and is the co-founder of Rabbit, maker of the purportedly AI-powered R1 device, and Cyber Manufacture Co. is the same company as Rabbit Inc.

statement.excerpt: I’m talking about it because the CEO of GAMA was and is Jesse Lyu, the co-founder of Rabbit, the company that makes the purportedly AI-powered R1 device, and that Cyber Manufacture Co. is the same company as Rabbit Inc.

from_speaker: the CEO of GAMA was and is Jesse Lyu
the company that makes the purportedly AI-powered R1 device
Cyber Manufacture Co. is the same company as Rabbit Inc.
our_interpretation: The claim requires both a past GAMA CEO role and continued service as GAMA's CEO on May 6, 2024. Leading the company that previously operated GAMA does not by itself establish continued leadership of GAMA.

The historical portion has no specified starting date. The present-tense portion concerns the latest publicly reportable leadership and corporate identity as of publication, rather than a quarterly reporting period.
Same company means continuity of the legal entity through a name change, rather than merely shared founders, staff or investors.
Purportedly AI-powered describes how the R1 was presented. It is not a conditional antecedent or a claim that its advertised capabilities worked.
Support requires evidence for every material component. Confirmation of some components with an unresolved remainder does not establish the whole claim.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish that Jesse Lyu previously served as GAMA's CEO and still held that role on May 6, 2024; that he co-founded Rabbit, which made and marketed the R1 as an AI device; and that Cyber Manufacture Co. and Rabbit Inc. were the same legal entity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that a material component is false, including that Lyu's GAMA CEO role had ended before May 6, 2024. A corporate pivot, inactivity or missing leadership records alone does not establish that his role ended.
